## 🏈 NFL Scores — Alfred Workflow
### Usage | Type this | What you get | |-----------|-------------| | `nfl` | Current week's live, upcoming & final scores | | `nfls` | Standings grouped by all 8 NFL divisions | | `nflp {name}` | Player stats & headshots (e.g. `nflp mahomes`) | | `nflt {query}` | Team stats (e.g. `nflt chiefs`) |
### Modifier Keys - **Scores (`nfl`)**: - `⌘ Enter`: Open Game Box Score - `⌥ Enter`: Open Play-by-Play - **Team Stats (`nflt`)**: - Default: Season record, division rank, streak, PF, PA - `⌘`: Team Offense (Points/Game, Passing YDS & TDs, Rushing YDS) - `⌥`: Team Defense (Sacks, Interceptions, Forced Fumbles, Tackles) - **Player Stats (`nflp`)**: - `⌘ Enter`: Open Player Game Log - `⌥ Enter`: Open Split Stats
### Features - **Dual team matchup logos** — away + home side-by-side on a 64x64 canvas - **Live game situations** — quarter, clock, down & distance, yard line, and red zone alerts - **Live auto-refresh** — scores update every 5s during live games - **Player headshots** — live from ESPN CDN, cached 7 days locally - **Timezone auto-detect** — game times formatted in your Mac's local timezone - **No API key needed** — free public ESPN API endpoints - **Zero dependencies** — pure-Python PNG compositing and bundled HTTP libraries
Built with ❤️ for Alfred 5.
